visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair wearing a cream-colored zip-up jacket over a white t-shirt and grey pants stands in a bright, modern garage. He is facing the camera, gesturing with his right hand. To his right is a dark, glossy car reflecting the studio's ceiling lights. The background features yellow walls and industrial-style glass partitions. (2) The scene shifts to a large yellow wall inside the facility featuring the text "WELCOME 大大力良品歡迎您" and a graphic of a car silhouette. The lighting is bright and even, coming from a grid of overhead panels that provide professional-grade illumination. (3) The main character returns to the center of the frame, continuing to speak with high energy while pointing towards a sleek black car. The environment includes various detailing equipment, such as a yellow pressure washer hose and specialized LED lighting arrays designed for paint inspection. (4) A tight close-up shot focuses on a hand operating a mechanical rotary polisher on the hood of a black vehicle. White polishing cream is spread across the paint. The reflections of the overhead tube lights are sharp and well-defined on the polished surface. (5) A split-screen comparison is shown where water is sprayed onto two different sections of car paint. One side shows heavy water residue and irregular sheeting, while the other side demonstrates extreme hydrophobicity with water beading into perfectly round droplets that roll off immediately. (6) The narrator is joined by a store manager wearing a bright yellow polo shirt. They stand at the rear of a black BMW, discussing the service. The manager uses a yellow cloth to wipe the vehicle's exterior while detailing products are visible on shelves behind them. (7) An outdoor establishing shot shows the commercial building's upper facade with a large yellow brand sign under an overcast sky. The video then transitions back to the interior where the host concludes his presentation with enthusiastic hand gestures in front of the car. (8) A final static graphic fills the entire screen, displaying the brand logo "Darry King Car Detailing" and a comprehensive price list for different warranty periods. Additional logos for partner brands like "System X" are shown at the bottom against a clean white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic male voice begins speaking Mandarin Chinese immediately. The delivery is rapid and entusiastic, typical of promotional social media content. Accompanying the speech is an upbeat electronic pop background track with a prominent synthesized bassline and a steady rhythmic beat. (2) A sharp digital "pop" sound effect triggers as emphasis text appears. The narrator's voice maintains a high level of arousal, with frequent pitch fluctuations. The background music continues at a consistent tempo of approximately 124 BPM, providing a modern, high-energy atmosphere. (3) The mechanical whirring sound of a high-speed car polisher is clearly audible, creating a textured layer of incidental noise. The narrator's speech continues over this sound, requiring clear articulation to remain the dominant signal. The room acoustics suggest a large, reflective indoor space. (4) The sound of rushing water and spraying liquid is introduced, representing a hydrophobic test. These transient SFX are layered over the continuous BGM and the narrator's voice. The vocal intensity remains moderate-high, effectively communicating the benefits of the product being demonstrated in the garage. (5) A second male voice enters the conversation. This voice is deeper with a lower average pitch and a more professional, subdued tone. The background music dips slightly in volume to accommodate the dialogue exchange. Ambient noise of a busy workshop remains faintly audible in the background. (6) A transition whoosh sound effect signals the final segment of the video. The primary narrator returns to a high-arousal, fast-paced delivery style to announce a giveaway. The music swells slightly in loudness, building harmonic tension before concluding with a final synthesized stinger and silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial promotion for 'Darry King Car Detailing' (大大力良品鍍膜). It utilizes a high-energy influencer presentation to highlight the brand's unique selling points: low pricing, frequent service availability, and comprehensive warranty. The narrative uses side-by-side visual evidence of water resistance to prove product efficacy, followed by an interview to address common customer concerns about booking.
